headline: More Bangladeshi firms eye direct US cotton sourcing as lower price offered: Supplier
summary: AmeriBangla says it has confirmed cotton supplies to four Bangladeshi companies. It plans to scale shipments to around 32,000 tonnes a month within two years.
why: Cotton is a key input for Bangladesh's garment industry, the country's main export sector, so sourcing costs and suppliers affect textile producers' margins.

impacts.name: Cotton
impacts.why: Bangladeshi buyers shifting to direct US cotton supply changes demand patterns for US-grown cotton.
